title: SS28 Kids' Trim Market Strategy
summary: Trim strategy for SS28 kidswear: durable, verifiable and easy to change late.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 kidswear fairs (Pitti Bimbo and Playtime) take place in June 2027. This report projects from SS28 adult previews, the SS27 kidswear fair record and long-term drivers such as heat and UV protection, and will be updated after the fairs.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Fashion is expected to remain in low single-digit growth in 2027; resale is expected to grow two to three times faster than first-hand fashion<sup>[1]</sup>
- C2 Fashion Studio calls SS28 "Structured Clarity": consumers "are no longer asking for more. They're asking for better"<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: Build, test, sell through
sections.body:
| Action | Trims |
|---|---|
| Build | Embroidery, printed labels |
| Test | Crochet trims |
| Avoid | Small parts, glued decoration |

design_implications:
- Document trim materials for any environmental claim.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Late-added trims (embroidery, piping) let you react to sales.
